about.title: An engineering team that takes technical challenges all the way to results
paragraphs: DefHat is a technology company working at the intersection of engineering, IT and supply. We take on complex technical requests — from requirements analysis and technology sourcing to development, integration and ongoing support.

Our team combines expertise in hardware and software development, data processing and artificial intelligence, communications, positioning and measurement systems, as well as international technology trade and logistics.
For our clients this means one accountable partner instead of several contractors: fewer hand-offs, transparent stages and a solution that works in your environment — not just on paper.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: Through the contact form we receive your name, work email, company name (optional) and the text of your request. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: The data is used solely to respond to your request and for related follow-up communication.

sections.title: Storage and sharing

sections.title: Your rights
